Description The project aimed to enhance Pinkerton is the leading Service institution that
provides services such as advisory, Security, Investigations, and other services to
corporations or large businesses, as required to individual members of the public,
Commercial business by implementing a comprehensive solution integrated with
Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and CRM. The objective was to streamline
operations, automate business processes, and ensure seamless synchronization
between financial, operational, and customer data.
I was responsible for gathering business requirements, conducting fit -gap analysis,
and preparing functional design documents. I collaborated closely with  business
stakeholders through workshops and client meetings to refine business rules and
ensure the solution aligned with operational needs.
A key aspect of the project involved designing and implementing integrations
between Dynamics 365 modules to enable real -time data flow across  systems,
improving data accuracy and reducing manual intervention. Additionally, I supported
the team in functional clarifications, provided end- user training, and delivered
product demonstrations to business SMEs.
This initiative resulted in improved operational efficiency, enhanced visibility into
vehicle and fleet data, and empowered the client with better decision - making
capabilities through integrated business intelligence.
